name: Select
description: Single-choice field that opens the DS option list (a select-only combobox), with labelled options, statuses, label-row actions and size tokens.

ariaRequirements: combobox named by the associated label
status message and helper linked with aria-describedby; error announced as an alert
a11y.reviewedNote: 2026-07-07 — beta→stable: 4-mode AT (base/light/dark/forced-colors) verified on a non-6010 Storybook; accessibility tree and real-browser forced-colors confirmed. 2026-10-30: engine changed from the native <select> to the Combobox select-only combobox (owner decision: DS list, never the OS popup); keyboard contract re-verified in unit tests (open, pick, Escape, type-ahead via Combobox). AT and forced-colors evidence must be recaptured before this ships.

label.description: Label text displayed above the select dropdown

options.description: Option objects with value, label, and optional disabled; children override this

helperText.description: Supporting text under the control; always rendered, below `error` when both are set.

error.description: Error message under the control; sets aria-invalid and aria-describedby.

status.description: Semantic state: colours the border and styles statusMessage. `error` overrides it.

statusMessage.description: Message under the control for `status`, above the helper line

actions.description: Icon buttons at the end of the label row: each runs an operation or opens a menu

disabled.description: Disables the select. Declared explicitly (not just via the native attribute extension) so the agent-blocks prop extraction sees it.

children.description: `<option>` or `SelectOption` children; an option with value "" becomes the placeholder

id.description: Explicit control id (wires the label); auto-generated when omitted

name.description: Submits the value with a surrounding form, through a hidden input

forbiddenUse: ship a Select with `value` and `defaultValue` both set; `value` wins and a dev warning fires.
use Select for a freeform value with suggestions; use TextInput.
render a native <select> beside or inside it; every DS dropdown opens the DS list.
dense: single choice on the DS list (Combobox engine): label, options or option children ('' = placeholder), status, helperText, actions, sm/md/lg, name; onValueChange(value)

usage.description: Select is the single-choice field. It renders Combobox's select-only combobox inside FieldShell, so it opens the same DS option list as every other dropdown on the site, never the operating system's popup. Feed it an options array or option children (an empty-value option becomes the placeholder) and read changes via onValueChange; pass name to submit with a native form.

bestPractices.description: Use Select for five or more exclusive options, or when space is tight; RadioGroup is better when all options should stay visible.
Lead with an empty placeholder option when there is no safe default, and validate it as unselected.
Do not use Select for search-among-many; Combobox owns typeahead.
Pass name when the field submits with a native form; a hidden input carries the selected value.
Do not silently preselect a consequential option (billing plans); make the user choose.
Keep option labels short; the list truncates nothing, so long labels wrap and slow scanning.
